original_ai_output.title_zh: 拉各斯一在建三层建筑倒塌致一人死亡，政府指责开发商
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚拉各斯州Fadeyi地区Akinola街一栋在建三层建筑倒塌，造成一人死亡、三人受伤。拉各斯州政府将事故归咎于开发商涉嫌偷工减料，并称该建筑此前已多次收到通知。目前信息来自单一来源报道。

location.raw_text: Akinola Street, off Ikorodu Road, Fadeyi area, Lagos

key_facts.fact: 拉各斯Fadeyi地区一栋在建三层建筑倒塌，造成一人死亡、三人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the collapse of a three-storey building under construction in the Fadeyi area of the state, which killed one person and injured three others

key_facts.fact: 拉各斯州政府将倒塌归咎于开发商涉嫌偷工减料
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Lagos State Government has blamed alleged corner-cutting by a developer for the collapse

key_facts.fact: 涉事建筑位于Akinola街，靠近Ikorodu路
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The building collapsed on Akinola Street, off Ikorodu Road.

key_facts.fact: 应急部门称该建筑此前已多次收到通知
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the structure had been served several notices before the incident

key_facts.fact: 周四12时45分接到求救电话后展开搜救行动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a distress call was received at 12.45 pm on Thursday, prompting a search-and-rescue operation

uncertainties: 开发商偷工减料的说法为政府指控，尚未经独立证实
目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
建筑此前收到通知的具体内容与次数未详细说明
